name: Disc Pool 2 Player
author: Addicting Games
description: Disc Pool Player 2 is the second part of your favorite sports game, Disc Pool Player. Play against the computer in this casual sports game. This is an online game decorated with neon colors as you play on a classic wooden board. On the right-hand side, you will see your level, score, and goal for that level. There are 3 levels for you to fight against the computer and win like the champ you are!. You’re on the green team and they’re on the red team and your goal is to get all of your discs into the pocket. If you don’t get any disc in or if you get the yellow or red disc in, it’s the computer’s turn. If you get your own green disc in the pocket, then you get to shoot again! Once you’ve finished all 3 levels, head to the High Scores icon to see if you’re in the top of the ranks for this puzzle game.
